label: Only 52% of callers reach a person
detail: Invoca studied over 70 million home service calls. Nearly half of callers did not reach a person.
source: Invoca Home Services Lead Conversion Benchmarks Report

label: Call a competitor when you do not answer
detail: In a survey, 82% of homeowners said they would call another business if no one answered.

label: Call another business immediately
detail: One in five homeowners said they would call another business right away.

label: Value after-hours AI answering
detail: Some customers said after-hours AI answering makes a business seem more reliable.
